title: At what lateness each laboratory feed's SLA alert should page the on-call officer
subdomain: disease surveillance and outbreak anomaly detection (attribution of a childcare room's cases to the index case by incubation window)
prompt_shape: other: a dial per laboratory feed (six feeds, seven allowed settings) with the expected secondary cases at the setting and the next longer one, each condition's transmission, and two asks per feed on the platform's message log and case extract

sources.origin: generated by task232/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional local health district's public health unit (Coast and Ranges) and its laboratories; no real person, laboratory, centre or case is depicted.

files.source: Constructed (seeded generator): Every message the Notifiable Conditions Platform accepted from the six laboratory feeds for a resident of the district, 1 October 2022 to 31 October 2026, all notifiable conditions except COVID-19 (which reaches the platform through the national results gateway). A message carries one laboratory report: one test's result on one specimen, as the laboratory authorised it.
Constructed (seeded generator): The enteric team's case extract: one row per case of an enteric condition the platform holds for the district, opened 1 October 2022 to 31 October 2026.
